points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable source clean-builds in isolated network-disabled cfd-bench; CTest registers no tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Case/output/restart and control overrides in main.cpp; no production solver rerun.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate case, mesh, partition, solver and output files; fixed 2-D state remains.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal executable wrapper found in source; external similarity investigation excluded under trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: CGNS mesh/case/BC paths are case-configured; unsupported CGNS MIXED elements are not parsed.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:42–60 root-only global mesh, METIS partitions and local/ghost exchanges; submitted rank-study executable hashes unbound.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity and finite checks exist, but output.cpp:272–291 ignores fread return values for restart payloads.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Eight output packages passed validator; isolated build succeeds, no registered CTests and no unsteady rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Documented code, scripts and original 66-figure manifest; data live in workspace and metadata revision is stale.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: 2-D compressible perfect-gas conservative equations and reference coefficients documented and implemented.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: Separate TRI_3/QUAD_4/BAR_2 multizone sections handled; CGNS MIXED unsupported.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Cell-face conservative residual and MPI norms present; low-Mach Rusanov over-dissipation produces large known errors.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov in steady low-Mach produces strong documented dissipation; Roe/entropy-fix transient, no independent shock study.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip, no-slip adiabatic paths; surface output explicitly reports boundary zero velocity.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Weighted least-squares face reconstruction and positivity fallback are source-supported; no independent smooth-order test.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkat limiter present; transient loop freezes predictor limiter through inner convergence, without refreshed target recheck.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Tangential skin-friction force projection is implemented; low-Mach laminar forces substantially inaccurate and disclosed.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS present, but M2 laminar residual-only early stop occurs with rapidly evolving drag.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 and predictor-frozen limiter inner iteration implemented; post-refresh target fraction unknown. Delivered segment t600–900, no unsteady rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Root preprocessing, METIS owned/ghost and halos; NACA/Re20 np1/2/4/8 final coefficients closely agree, though exact binary hashes unbound.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Validator accepted eight original outputs; an accepted structural status does not establish physics or force convergence.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Recorded examiner validation rc0; Re200 not rerun and numerical truth assessed independently.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M2 laminar completed/converged at1000 despite Cd0.673434→0.569866 final100; DQ7.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd6.03 vs report literature≈2 and M015 lam Cd0.489 are stable but very inaccurate; Re200 Cd1.218/St0.173 plausible.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Original dd0fabf and manifest deliver readable Re200 late lift/drag, but startup spikes compress both late M015/M080 laminar traces.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report candidly discloses low-Mach limitations but calls M2 early result converged; Re200 predecessor chain differs from the simplified restart description.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Original 66-figure manifest and isolated exact Re20 force/residual/Mach plot regeneration; historic binary identity and other image bindings unproven.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean 4698ba1 CMake build succeeds network-disabled with 2 CPUs, 3GiB,256 process limit. Validator accepted output contract; CTest has no registered tests and restart fread returns are unchecked.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: main.cpp:42–60 root-loads CGNS and partitions; mesh.cpp:184–212 handles separate TRI_3/QUAD_4/BAR_2 sections, not CGNS MIXED.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative cell-face residual, Rusanov/Roe and no-slip adiabatic paths are implemented; substantial low-Mach dissipation limits accuracy and no independent order study performed.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Weighted least-squares reconstruction, Venkat limiter and positivity fallback exist; no independent smooth-grid order test or exact historical executable binding.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: solver.cpp:1104–1122 integrates tangential wall traction, :1167–1170 writes wall-boundary zero velocity. Viscous results are severely over-dissipated in low-Mach cases.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: LU-SGS steady and BDF2 time-history loop exist; M2 early steady stop ignores clear force drift. Solver.cpp:1497–1508 freezes limiter for inner convergence and does not recheck target after refresh, so actual refreshed miss fraction is unknown.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS root partitioning, owned/ghost halos and reductions are present. Rank-study metadata controls match but git_revision is initial baseline and exact historic executables remain unbound.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: M2 laminar is falsely marked converged with large drag drift; M015 laminar and Re20 are stable but Cd0.489 and6.03 are far above physical expectations, explicitly disclosed. Re200 periodic Cd1.218/St0.173 is supported with frozen-limiter and restart qualifications.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: All14 accepted PDF pages reviewed; report candidly discloses low-Mach accuracy failures but calls unstable early M2 laminar converged. Startup spikes flatten both late steady laminar forces; Re200 late force is delivered in original manifest, outside curated image subset.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Modular mesh/partition, case, solver and output, but fixed 2-D four-component state limits 3-D/EOS extension.

naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Final Cd0.065395, Cl0.000481; last five 1000-row mean Cd0.06747,0.06540,0.06531,0.06540,0.06528. The visibly settled positive drag is extremely high for this symmetric low-Mach inviscid case, consistent with the report’s disclosed Rusanov dissipation limitation. Score5→2.5 for accuracy, without inferring false success from drag magnitude alone.

naca0012_m080_inviscid.notes: Final Cd0.050896, Cl−0.001511; last5000 force rows have Cd means 0.05100,0.05088,0.05089,0.05089,0.05090. Report discloses limiter/shock residual limit cycle and high low-Mach dissipation. Score5→3.5 for residual/accuracy confidence; no DQ inferred solely from the plateau.

naca0012_m200_inviscid.notes: Final Cd0.093723, Cl−0.000996, residual target reached at2800. Force plot exposes transient approach; plausible wave drag but no independent order or exact historic binary attribution. Score5→4. Original delivered `dd0fabf:solver/report/figures/naca0012_m200_inviscid_mach.png` SHA256 177d47a863128257ce202868ec19072b43eeb946c601b3ffe36160f43529a5ed visibly resolves the near-body field; case residual image SHA256 b1a6fa3b3ea327f339f7171bad94ca6c0701da0e2b7a831e5a02290210b24979 is listed in the manifest.

naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000.notes: Final Cd0.488735 is almost an order of magnitude above a typical low-Re airfoil value; report/limitations_body.tex:3–17 itself labels viscous-dominated drag qualitative because of Rusanov dissipation. Last100 Cd0.488734998→0.488735051 is stable; this is an accuracy finding, not proof of false convergence. Delivered immutable dd0fabf force PNG SHA256 9ddbfcfd0dab544da8b89e09b74903090c71390d88bfcc7cbfab7efbdffa2405 uses a shared scale with startup Cd>300, flattening both late forces; score5→1.5 for quality and evidence floor.

naca0012_m080_laminar_re5000.notes: Final Cd0.154603 and last100 0.154384→0.154603, while final five 1000-row mean Cd0.14780,0.14307,0.14611,0.15021,0.15339 limit plateau confidence. Original delivered dd0fabf force PNG SHA256 b7cf840cfe778cd98cd3e3b9c8fe0fe774743bc2ec792837ebb475d52263e8e5 uses a shared axis with startup Cd>300, flattening both late force traces; score5→2 under the independent visual floor. No additional DQ from this plot alone.

naca0012_m200_laminar_re5000.notes: Immutable 4698ba1 report/results_body.tex:80–90 gives final Cd0.5699 and reports convergence at1000 steps. Submitted metadata SHA256 46ca7bfc0c841560b787e29dfdbaf5143905e43deb041159407c46cae516d68e says completed/converged, but force CSV SHA256 d88744c1fe8d5fed2dc4d294a371b58c6c5995a01cc77a466ed59cd488ad419e shows Cd0.673434→0.569866 final100, 0.618365→0.569866 final50 and 0.588552→0.569866 final20. TASK.md:140,172 requires clear early laminar convergence and stable forces; actual 3.036-order residual reduction is not disputed. DQ7; old score5→1. The remaining evidence and rubric were subsequently reviewed with the documented historic-binary qualification.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re20.notes: Final Cd6.027568, Cl−0.000770, last100 Cd6.027556→6.027568. Immutable report/results_body.tex:93–95 and limitations_body.tex:10–17 explicitly compare Cd≈6 to literature ≈2 and disclose low-Mach dissipation; stable force does not rescue the large physical error. The original force chart exposes overall Cd history despite a startup spike. Score5→2 for physical accuracy, not for unproven nonconvergence.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Contestant final response explicitly delivers 66-figure manifest. Immutable contestant final dd0fabfcc023518344f059416ab2d778a5f730af includes figure_manifest.csv SHA256 bc05797da6717343052ed4709630d9c5afeb00a6d6d1367d607a8f79a184a500 and Re200 force/residual PNGs SHA256 7b0360860baa908f3224b4d4a5672ac4f6b092d99c4762bdc81ad2f789b0e672 / 099200a9f1de5e1666813d32bb768709f195014d6cbf3743bf0bfc6ad4f16b65; force PNG visibly resolves late lift and drag. Curated tip omits those images but report/results_body.tex:115–118 gives Cd1.218, lift −0.456..0.482 and St0.173, with wake contour. Workspace force CSV SHA256 ba0fde273956c65831770077a10a200020bab3756d712e13278c97a0413d069f t>=750 gives Cd1.218117, lift −0.456063..0.481777, 26 upcrossings St0.173004. Actual delivered segment time600.01–900 after restart from _re200_roe_prod, whereas report describes restart from steady Rusanov state; provenance of predecessor/actual executable needs further review. Solver source freezes limiter after first inner iteration; recorded target fraction refers to frozen-limiter residual, and full refreshed-limiter target miss count is unproven. Previous note falsely asserted no force/residual; score2→4. No unsteady run.

flags.evidence: Generic CGNS reader and case configuration are present.

flags.evidence: Re20 np1/2/4/8 Cd6.027177/6.027224/6.027004/6.027568; M015 np1/2/4/8 Cd0.065210/0.065218/0.065189/0.065395, no order-one absolute discrepancy. Metadata controls match but exact binary hashes unknown; near-zero lift relative ratios are not treated as order-one.

flags.text: The solver uses explicit time stepping only
flags.evidence: Implicit steady and BDF2 dual-time paths are source-supported.

flags.text: The report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful final results
flags.evidence: M2 laminar metadata SHA256 46ca7bfc0c841560b787e29dfdbaf5143905e43deb041159407c46cae516d68e marks completed/converged at step1000, repeated by immutable 4698ba1 solver/report/results_body.tex:80–82. Force SHA256 d88744c1fe8d5fed2dc4d294a371b58c6c5995a01cc77a466ed59cd488ad419e shows Cd0.6734338→0.5698661 final100 and 0.6183646→0.5698661 final50; this early laminar state is not clearly converged or force-stable (TASK.md:140,172), despite an actual 3.036-order residual drop. Other numbered DQ criteria were subsequently assessed in the qualified full review. Stable but inaccurate Re20 and M015 laminar cases are not separately alleged falsely converged.

flags.text: Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
flags.evidence: Original delivered figure manifest maps plots to source; isolated Re20 force/residual/Mach redraws reproduce original pixels. Other cases not individually bound; no specific figure/data mismatch established.

flags.text: metadata.json reports METIS/ParMETIS but code uses only a geometric split or full-state replication
flags.evidence: main.cpp:42–60 root-loads global mesh for METIS partitioning, solve loads local partitions and source exchanges halos; no prohibited all-rank full replication demonstrated.

flags.text: A report claims second-order reconstruction or a shock limiter that is disabled for production cases
flags.evidence: Source supports production reconstruction/limiter and metadata reports them; no evidence of disabled production scheme established. Exact historical executable unbound.

flags.text: Surface no-slip checks fail because reported wall rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
flags.evidence: solver.cpp:1167–1170 emits no-slip boundary u=v=0 rather than labeling adjacent cell-center velocity as wall value.

flags.text: Figure files are misnamed, such as a Mach image that actually plots pressure
flags.evidence: No misnaming was established in report/manifest inspection.

flags.text: The finite-volume solver core, time integration, or MPI communication is copied, adapted, or wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
flags.evidence: No direct internal wrapper/copy evidence found; external similarity investigation is excluded by trust policy.

limitations: Re200 original contestant segment is t600.01–900 from a Roe transient predecessor; the report summarizes its earlier steady restart. No unsteady rerun.
Full refreshed-limiter target miss fraction and exact historical executable hashes remain unproven; Re200 selected-session build/commit/launch sequence is documented.
Re20 force/residual/Mach image-to-data reproduction is exact; other image bindings unverified. Selected primary session excludes setup root, aggregate telemetry remains contaminated.
